subject: Continuous 3-D Latent Diffusion: A New Bridge Between Sparse Measurements and Full-Volume Imaging
script: From Agewell Brief: Continuous 3-D Latent Diffusion: A New Bridge Between Sparse Measurements and Full-Volume Imaging. A new framework generates coherent CT and MRI volumes from sparse data using a continuous latent diffusion model, echoing the mathematical foundations of tomographic reconstruction. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
